title: クラシックに向けた記者会見

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: During her interview at the Satsuki Sho press conference, Tokai Teio declares she will become a Triple Crown champion.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, that dream won't come true so easily. In order to catch up to and eventually surpass the great Symboli Rudolf…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tokai Teio pulls out all the stops and trains like never before.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile, Symboli Rudolf watches from the sidelines, quietly admitting that she has been waiting for someone like Teio to challenge her.
